rows.endpoint_definition: share of patients graded excellent (90-100% repigmentation) at their last follow-up
rows.time_from_last_treatment: 9 to 10 months after the dermabrasion + SBEG operation (patients 10, 11 and 19, Table I) [the operation is treated as the final treatment: the source describes one procedure and no later pigment treatment, but does not state that none was given]
